string.text: CS-3a body armor
PSZ-9d Duty Armor
PS5-M Universal Protection
Exoskeleton
PSZ-12V Bulat
This exoskeleton provides outstanding protection against bullet and fragmentation damage at the cost of mobility. Vulnerable to armor-piercing rounds.
Exoskeleton

A military armored suit made for assault operations. Provides outstanding protection against full metal jacket rounds and fragmentation damage without reducing the wearer's mobility. Vulnerable to armor-piercing rounds.
Military armored suit

A regular black leather trench coat. Has no special purpose other than to keep the wearer warm at night or protect him from a blind dog bite. Although the trench coat is not particularly comfortable, it is often used by bandits in the Zone - either because it allows them to hide in the dark or simply due to its "cool" appearance.
Leather trench coat
SEVA bodysuit
Berill-5M armored suit
Sphere M12 helmet

An aluminum/titanium helmet with a cloth exterior that comes with pockets for additional steel armor pieces and an armor face mask. Sphere M12 is normally used as part of a combination that includes PSZ series Spetsnaz body armor. Quite popular in the Zone thanks to its respirator and built-in first generation night vision device, as well as providing the maximum head protection possible. Comes with electronics slots.
Steel helmet

A desperately outdated steel army helmet without any additions. Provides no protection against anomalies or radiation, but can deflect bullets. This helmet was never particularly popular in the Zone, except for use in brief armed conflicts between factions.
Aurora gas mask

A regular plastic and rubber gas mask, used for filtering air for radioactive particles and poisonous substances. Widely used by rookies and veterans of all factions due to its universal functionality. Does not provide any physical protection.
Tactical helmet

A Western model of a tactical helmet that lacks camouflage. It is not known how it made its way into the Zone. The helmet is designed to provide a squad leader with strategic superiority over the enemy via its many scanners and satellite communications devices, which have not been installed in this particular helmet. Comes with multi-layered Kevlar protection and armored elements to protect electronic components. Includes a respirator and a first generation night vision device.
Sunrise bodysuit
PSZ-5V Freedom Guard

This lightweight stalker bodysuit is made by Freedom craftsmen. The suit's fabric is treated with Horizon, a special solution developed by the faction by trial and error to increase resistance to anomalies. Like the Sunrise suit, the Wind of Freedom comes with built-in body armor and artifact containers.
Wind of Freedom bodysuit

This modern version of the Duty bodysuit is better suited for stalker recruits who are used to lightweight suits. Unlike the PSZ series, this suit provides good protection against anomalies while also being capable of stopping a pistol bullet. The suit cannot be modified with an artifact container, but may be upgraded with a combat support system instead.

This modern military armored suit is designed for assault operations in anomalous areas. Comprises a PSZ-12p heavy military armored suit, built-in compensation suit, and an anomalous protection bodysuit. The armor provides excellent protection against bullet and fragmentation damage, without greatly reducing the wearer's mobility. Does not come with an artifact container.

This bodysuit, intended for conducting research in the Zone, combines a closed-cycle respiratory module and an external isolation coating, resulting in excellent protection from anomalies. Due to poor protection from physical impact, the suit is not a good defense against bullet and fragmentation damage. Comes with a built-in artifact transportation container.

This suit, produced by one of Kiev's Defense Research Institutes, is a great alternative to homemade stalker suits. While its built-in body armor can only stop a pistol round, the anomaly and radiation protection system is second to none. Fully upgradeable and boasting two built-in artifact containers, this bodysuit is the equipment of choice for many experienced stalkers.

This item comprises military PS5 series body armor with beryllium sputter modified for use in the Zone. Designed for assault operations in highly radioactive areas, it is ineffective in areas of high anomalous activity. The suit makes its way to stalkers through the military, who exchange it for loot. Does not come with an artifact container.

This DIY stalker bodysuit is a combination of a bodysuit of twin-layered rubberized cloth with plexiglass lining and built-in body armor. Despite the fact that the body armor is incapable of protecting the wearer from even pistol bullets, the suit enjoys great popularity due to its low cost and modification potential. Comes with built-in artifact containers.

This stalker bodysuit with reinforced body armor made by Freedom craftsmen represents a good compromise between combat and anomaly protection. The built-in body armor comprises armor plating and ten Kevlar layers, capable of stopping a pistol bullet. The suit uses the relatively expensive Sovereign compound for anomaly protection. Comes with an artifact container.

This early model of the Duty bodysuit is the Spetsnaz PSZ-9 body armor modified for the Zone. The suit is capable of stopping a rifle bullet, however, this level of protection comes at the cost of its weight, bulkiness and virtually non-existent anomaly protection. The suit cannot be modified with an artifact container, but may be upgraded with a combat support system.

Once used as standard by Clear Sky assault squads, after the faction’s elimination this armor serves as a reminder that even an excellent protective bodysuit cannot guarantee you safety this side of the perimeter. The armor is capable of stopping a pistol bullet, while the wearer is also well protected from anomalies. Comes with a two built-in artifact container.

An experimental sample of a military exoskeleton. Was never mass-produced due to extraordinary cost and some design flaws. Despite this, it is in demand due to its ability to take on the weight of all carried equipment, and therefore small batches are made in underground facilities outside Ukraine. Comes with a built-in artifact container.
SEVA bodysuit
SSP-99 protection suit

The SSP-99 chemical protection suit is specially designed by the Ecologists for use in the Zone. It features an integrated air-filtering and air-conditioning system. It is also heat and electricity resistant, and provides good protection against radiation and chemically aggressive environments. It is not designed for combat, so it provides little bullet and splinter protection. Comes with two artefact containers.
SSP-99M protection suit

The SSP-99M is a high quality variant of the standard SSP-99 Ecologist suit, providing increased defence against bullet and splinter damage, being designed for guards working with scientific expeditions. Comes with two artefact containers.
Zircon suit

Standard body armour worn by the Monolith faction. Whilst many variants exist to improve their scientific or combat abilities, this model is the most common, being based on the Sunrise suit used by ordinary stalkers. Comes with two artefact containers.
Leather Jacket
An ordinary, thick leather jacket, one of many. The leather provides some protection from fire or claws, but is utterly useless against anomalies and radiation.
Black Jacket
An ordinary black leather jacket from this brand's series, common throughout the Zone. It became very popular with bandits and is considered the faction's unofficial dress code.
Mercenary suit

Outfit of choice for the Mercenary faction. Its design is based on the suit used by the special forces of Western armies. Thanks to a special treatment of the fabric, the armour has a strengthened stability during the physical movement of its plates. Comes with a built-in artefact container.
Marauder suit

A lightweight jumpsuit used by mercenaries that "accidentally" fell into the hands of bandits. It is based on equipment samples used by Western special forces. Ironically, whoever sold these jumpsuits to the bandits seems to have taken advantage of their gullibility, as the protective characteristics of the gear are far inferior to the original.
SEVA-M bodysuit

The Monolith scientific suit includes a flak vest of unknown origin and also features unique modifications for greater resistance to radiation at the cost of being more vulnerable to psi-fields. The anomaly protection system has been upgraded to match the SEVA bodysuit. Comes with two built-in artefact containers.
Ruby Exoskeleton

Painted in Monolith colours, this exoskeleton includes a flak vest of unknown origin and also features unique modifications creating a slight resistance to radiation. The system has been upgraded to near-military levels of protection at the cost of having no psi-protection whatsoever. Comes with two artefact containers.
Cuirass Exoskeleton

The exoskeleton variant produced by Duty uses heavier materials to improve bullet resistance over that of other exoskeletons. At the cost of its resistance towards projectiles is its weak anomaly protection. Does not come with an artefact container.
Liberty Exoskeleton

An upgraded version of a regular exoskeleton. The use of lighter materials has allowed its designers to reduce the weight of the suit, and with Freedom's usual trademark of high quality anomaly protection, the only thing that suffers is its overall armour and impact protection. Comes with a built-in artefact container.
Brummbar Exoskeleton
An experimental sample of the exoskeleton often worn by veterans of the Mercenary faction, repainted in the faction's typical colours. Comes with two built-in artefact containers.
SEVA-K bodysuit

A suit used by mercenaries who often work in or near anomalous areas. It includes a protection system with a closed cycle, built-in suppression action anomalous fields. It provides good protection from bullet and shrapnel hit, but not enough for large-scale hostilities. Fully upgradeable and boasting two built-in artefact containers.
SEVA-V bodysuit

Produced by Freedom specially for research in the Zone. The closed system of breathing and special treatment materials provide excellent protection against harmful radiation and anomalous effects. However, the built-in body armour is not the best, and can break somewhat easily, so it is unsuitable for active hostilities. Fully upgradeable and boasting two built-in artefact containers.
SEVA-D bodysuit

A wonderful protective suit for the Zone, mostly appreciated because it combines excellent anomaly with good bullet-proofing qualities. It includes a modified PS5-M suit, a closed cycle breathing system and an integrated system of anomalous field suppression. Unlike other duty outfits, it comes with two artefact containers.
XM40 Gas Mask

Extremely popular among mercenaries. It consists of a gas mask and a multi-layer 40-millimeter filter. The XM40 provides good protection in chemically and radiologically contaminated environments, even if the mask is partially damaged.
"Corundum-D" Armored Suit

One of the best means of individual protection. Consists of three elements - tactical helmet, heavy armored vest, and reinforced overalls. The vest is made of several thick layers of Kevlar and can be reinforced with titanium or steel plates. Equipped with an artifact container.
"Corundum" Armored Suit

This suit, manufactured by one of Kyiv's defense research institutes, represents the pinnacle of personal protection technology. Consists of three elements - tactical helmet, heavy armored vest, and reinforced overalls. The vest is made of several thick layers of Kevlar and can be reinforced with titanium or steel plates. Comes with a built-in artifact container.
"Corundum-M" Armored Suit

One of the best means of individual protection for the Monolith. Consists of three elements - tactical helmet, heavy armored vest, and reinforced overalls. The vest is made of several thick layers of Kevlar and can be reinforced with titanium or steel plates. Equipped with two built-in artifact containers.
Optician gas mask

A regular plastic and rubber gas mask, used for filtering air for radioactive particles and poisonous substances. Widely used by rookies and veterans of all factions due to its universal functionality. Does not provide any physical protection.
Ballistic Helmet
Headgear providing basic protection, capable of stopping a pistol round. A gas mask is not included.
